+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)

+from ansible.module_utils.facts.sysctl import get_sysctl, get_uptime_facts
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.openbsd import OpenBSDHardware
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('line', [
+    'kern.osrelease=7.6',
+    'kern.osrelease: 7.6',
+    'kern.osrelease 7.6',
+])
+def test_sysctl_delimiters(line):
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, line, '')
+
+    assert get_sysctl(module, ['kern']) == {'kern.osrelease': '7.6'}
+
+
+def test_sysctl_multiline_and_malformed_lines():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.get_bin_path.return_value = '/sbin/sysctl'

+        'kern.last': 'three',
+    }

+
+

+    assert module.warn.call_args[0][0].startswith('Unable to read sysctl: ')
+
+

+            setattr(hardware, method, Mock(return_value=result))

+        assert all(facts[key] == value for key, value in result.items())
